caption_draft: **Transaction-class leakage under session-disjoint evaluation:** (a) balanced accuracy, (b) mutual information, over 22 leave-one-session-out folds.
statistical_method: Leave-one-session-out cross-validation over 22 sessions; random forest, 120 trees, min_samples_leaf 5. Mutual information estimated per held-out session and summed over features. Three-class chance balanced accuracy is 1/3.
